title: Dear Santa I've Been Mostly Good Christmas Stocking, Funny Reindeer Stocking, Personal Holiday Stocking, Cute Family Christmas Decor
description:
An innocent little reindeer with a golden halo, sitting on a pile of presents, and a very honest note for Santa: "DEAR SANTA, I'VE BEEN (MOSTLY) GOOD".

A funny and cosy stocking to hang on the fireplace, the staircase or the bedroom door. A sweet gift for kids, couples or the whole family, and a lovely way to start a Christmas tradition.

DETAILS
- Soft fleece (100% polyester), one size
- Printed all over: design on the front, red snowflake pattern on the back
- Twill ribbon hanging loop

CARE
Spot clean or hand wash cold. Do not iron directly on the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 1-3 business days. Free shipping within the USA; this item ships to the USA and Canada only.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
